pagetitle: "Peekbank | Visualizations"
title: "Interactive visualizations"
---

Explore the time course of children's word recognition across the datasets in
[Peekbank](https://peekbank.github.io/peekbank-website/). Pick datasets, an
age range, and words; the plots update as you go. These are the same analyses
as the classic Peekbank Shiny app (following Fernald et al., 2008), computed
in your browser from the current database release.

{{< include components/_interval.qmd >}}
{{< include components/_vizlib.qmd >}}

```{ojs manifest}
//| output: false
manifest = d3.json("slices/manifest.json")
datasetNames = manifest.datasets.map((d) => d.name)
```

::: {.pb-controls}

```{ojs control-dataset}
viewof sel_datasets = Inputs.select(datasetNames, {
  label: "Datasets",
  multiple: 6,
  value: ["pomper_saffran_2016"],
})
```

```{ojs control-age}

  step: 1, value: [0, 84], label: "Ages to include (months)",
})
```

```{ojs control-nbins}

```

```{ojs control-word}
viewof sel_words = Inputs.select(["All"].concat(allWords), {

```

```{ojs control-plotwin}

```


```{ojs slice-loading}
//| output: false
sliceCache = new Map()

async function loadSlice(name) {
  if (!sliceCache.has(name)) {
    sliceCache.set(name, await d3.json(`slices/datasets/${name}.json`));
  }
  return sliceCache.get(name);
}

slices = Promise.all(sel_datasets.map(loadSlice))
```

```{ojs joined}
//| output: false
// flatten selected slices into one trial-level structure
allWords = {
  const w = new Set();
  for (const s of slices) {
    for (const tt of s.trial_types) if (tt[1] != null) w.add(tt[1]);
  }
  return Array.from(w).sort();
}

joined = {
  const useAll = sel_words.includes("All");
  const wordSet = new Set(sel_words);
  const [ageLo, ageHi] = age_range;
  const rows = []; // one row per run-group (trial administration)
  for (const s of slices) {
    const adminById = new Map(s.admins.map((a) => [a[0], a]));
    const ttById = new Map(s.trial_types.map((t) => [t[0], t]));
    const trialById = new Map(s.trials.map((t) => [t[0], t]));
    for (const [aid, tid, t0, runs] of s.runs) {
      const admin = adminById.get(aid);
      if (!admin || admin[1] == null || admin[1] < ageLo || admin[1] > ageHi) continue;
      const trial = trialById.get(tid);
      if (!trial) continue;
      if (!include_excluded && trial[3] === 1) continue;
      const tt = ttById.get(trial[2]);
      if (!tt) continue;
      const word = tt[1];
      if (!useAll && !wordSet.has(word)) continue;
      rows.push({
        dataset: s.dataset.name, aid, tid, t0, runs,
        age: admin[1], subject: admin[2],
        word: useAll ? "All" : word, trial_order: trial[1],
      });
    }
  }
  return rows;
}

binner = {
  const ages = Array.from(new Set(joined.map((r) => r.age)));
  return makeAgeBinner(ages, age_nbins);
}

groupedRows = joined.map((r) => ({ ...r, age_bin: binner.labels[binner.bin(r.age)] }))
```

```{ojs profile-agg}
//| output: false
profileData = {
  const [tLo, tHi] = plot_window;
  const acc = new Map(); // `${t}|${bin}|${word}` -> {t, bin, word, n, p}
  for (const r of groupedRows) {
    let t = r.t0;
    for (const [aoi, len] of r.runs) {
      for (let k = 0; k < len; k++, t += STEP_MS) {
        if (t <= tLo || t >= tHi || aoi > 1) continue;
        const key = `${t}|${r.age_bin}|${r.word}`;
        let e = acc.get(key);
        if (!e) acc.set(key, e = { t, age_bin: r.age_bin, word: r.word, n: 0, p: 0 });
        e.n += 1;
        if (aoi === 0) e.p += 1;
      }
    }
  }
  const out = [];
  for (const e of acc.values()) {
    const [lo, hi] = bayesCI(e.p, e.n);
    out.push({
      t: e.t, age_bin: e.age_bin, word: e.word, n: e.n,
      prop_looking: e.p / e.n, ci_lower: lo, ci_upper: hi,
    });
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);
}
```

## Profile plot

Proportion of trials with looks to the target image (among target + distractor
looks) over time from target-word onset. The gray band marks the accuracy
analysis window; the dashed line is chance (0.5).

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Plot

```{ojs profile-plot}
{
  document.querySelectorAll(".pb-spinner").forEach((el) => el.remove());
  const colorField = age_as_color ? "age_bin" : "word";
  const facetField = age_as_color ? "word" : "age_bin";
  const facets = new Set(profileData.map((d) => d[facetField]));
  return Plot.plot({
    width, height: Math.max(360, 240 * Math.ceil(facets.size / 2)),
    marginRight: 40,
    grid: true,
    x: { label: "Time (msec)" },
    y: { label: "Proportion target looking", domain: [0, 1] },
    color: { legend: true, label: colorField === "age_bin" ? "Age group" : "Word" },
    fy: facets.size > 1 ? { label: null } : undefined,
    marks: [
      Plot.rectY([{ x1: analysis_window[0], x2: analysis_window[1] }],
        { x1: "x1", x2: "x2", y1: 0, y2: 1, fill: "#e5e7eb", opacity: 0.5 }),
      Plot.areaY(profileData, {
        x: "t", y1: "ci_lower", y2: "ci_upper", fill: colorField,
        opacity: 0.3, ...(facets.size > 1 ? { fy: facetField } : {}),
      }),
      Plot.lineY(profileData, {
        x: "t", y: "prop_looking", stroke: colorField,
        ...(facets.size > 1 ? { fy: facetField } : {}),
      }),
      Plot.ruleY([0.5], { strokeDasharray: "4 4" }),
      Plot.ruleX([0], { strokeDasharray: "4 4" }),
    ],
  });
}
```

### Data

```{ojs profile-table}
Inputs.table(profileData, {
  columns: ["t", "age_bin", "word", "n", "prop_looking", "ci_lower", "ci_upper"],
  format: {
    prop_looking: (d) => d.toFixed(3),
    ci_lower: (d) => d.toFixed(3),
    ci_upper: (d) => d.toFixed(3),
  },
})
```

## Accuracy

Mean proportion target looking per trial within the analysis window,
averaged across trials (95% CI = ±1.96 standard errors).

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Plot

```{ojs accuracy-agg}
//| output: false
accuracyData = {
  const [wLo, wHi] = analysis_window;
  const perTrial = [];
  for (const r of groupedRows) {
    let t = r.t0, n = 0, p = 0;
    for (const [aoi, len] of r.runs) {
      for (let k = 0; k < len; k++, t += STEP_MS) {
        if (t < wLo || t > wHi || aoi > 1) continue;
        n += 1;
        if (aoi === 0) p += 1;
      }
    }
    if (n > 0) perTrial.push({ age_bin: r.age_bin, word: r.word, prop: p / n });
  }
  const groups = d3.group(perTrial, (d) => d.age_bin, (d) => d.word);
  const out = [];
  for (const [bin, byWord] of groups) {
    for (const [word, rows] of byWord) {
      const mean = d3.mean(rows, (d) => d.prop);
      const sem = (d3.deviation(rows, (d) => d.prop) || 0) / Math.sqrt(rows.length);
      out.push({
        age_bin: bin, word, n_trials: rows.length, mean,
        ci_lower: mean - 1.96 * sem, ci_upper: mean + 1.96 * sem,
      });
    }
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.age_bin, b.age_bin));
}
```

```{ojs accuracy-plot}
{
  const xField = age_as_color ? "age_bin" : "word";
  const facetField = age_as_color ? "word" : "age_bin";
  const facets = new Set(accuracyData.map((d) => d[facetField]));
  return Plot.plot({
    width, height: Math.max(320, 220 * Math.ceil(facets.size / 3)),
    x: { label: xField === "age_bin" ? "Age (binned)" : "Word", tickRotate: facets.size > 4 ? 0 : 0 },
    y: { label: "Proportion target looking", domain: [0, 1] },
    color: { legend: false },
    fx: facets.size > 1 ? { label: null } : undefined,
    marks: [
      Plot.barY(accuracyData, {
        x: xField, y: "mean", fill: xField,
        ...(facets.size > 1 ? { fx: facetField } : {}),
      }),
      Plot.ruleX(accuracyData, {
        x: xField, y1: "ci_lower", y2: "ci_upper",
        ...(facets.size > 1 ? { fx: facetField } : {}),
      }),
      Plot.ruleY([0.5], { strokeDasharray: "4 4" }),
    ],
  });
}
```

### Data

```{ojs accuracy-table}
Inputs.table(accuracyData, {
  format: {
    mean: (d) => d.toFixed(3),
    ci_lower: (d) => d.toFixed(3),
    ci_upper: (d) => d.toFixed(3),
  },
})
```

## Reaction time

Latency to shift from the distractor to the target image after word onset
(distractor-initial trials only; landing-time RT following Fernald et al.,
2008).

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Plot

```{ojs rt-agg}
//| output: false
rtData = {
  const out = [];
  for (const r of groupedRows) {
    const res = trialRT(r.t0, r.runs);
    if (res && res.rt != null) {
      out.push({
        age_bin: r.age_bin, word: r.word, rt: res.rt,
        shift_type: res.shift_type, dataset: r.dataset,
      });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

rtMeans = {
  const dt = rtData.filter((d) => d.shift_type === "D-T");
  const out = [];
  for (const [bin, byWord] of d3.group(dt, (d) => d.age_bin, (d) => d.word)) {
    for (const [word, rows] of byWord) {
      const mean = d3.mean(rows, (d) => d.rt);
      const sem = (d3.deviation(rows, (d) => d.rt) || 0) / Math.sqrt(rows.length);
      out.push({
        age_bin: bin, word, n_trials: rows.length, mean_rt: mean,
        ci_lower: mean - 1.96 * sem, ci_upper: mean + 1.96 * sem,
      });
    }
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.age_bin, b.age_bin));
}
```

```{ojs rt-plot}
{
  const xField = age_as_color ? "age_bin" : "word";
  const facetField = age_as_color ? "word" : "age_bin";
  const facets = new Set(rtMeans.map((d) => d[facetField]));
  return Plot.plot({
    width, height: Math.max(320, 220 * Math.ceil(facets.size / 3)),
    x: { label: xField === "age_bin" ? "Age (binned)" : "Word" },
    y: { label: "Reaction time (msec)" },
    color: { legend: false },
    fx: facets.size > 1 ? { label: null } : undefined,
    marks: [
      Plot.barY(rtMeans, {
        x: xField, y: "mean_rt", fill: xField,
        ...(facets.size > 1 ? { fx: facetField } : {}),
      }),
      Plot.ruleX(rtMeans, {
        x: xField, y1: "ci_lower", y2: "ci_upper",
        ...(facets.size > 1 ? { fx: facetField } : {}),
      }),
    ],
  });
}
```

### RT histogram

```{ojs rt-hist}

  width, height: 320,
  x: { label: "RT (msec)" },
  y: { label: "Count" },
  color: { legend: true, label: "Age group" },
  marks: [
    Plot.rectY(rtData.filter((d) => d.shift_type === "D-T"),
      Plot.binX({ y: "count" }, {

})
```

## Onset-contingent looking

Proportion of trials on which children have shifted away from the image they
were fixating at word onset, split by whether they started on the distractor
(D-T, solid lines) or on the target (T-D, dashed lines).

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Plot

```{ojs onset-agg}
//| output: false
onsetData = {
  const [tLo, tHi] = plot_window;
  const shiftByTrial = new Map();
  for (const r of groupedRows) {
    const res = trialRT(r.t0, r.runs);
    if (res && (res.shift_type === "D-T" || res.shift_type === "T-D")) {
      shiftByTrial.set(`${r.aid}|${r.tid}`, res.shift_type);
    }
  }
  const acc = new Map();
  for (const r of groupedRows) {
    const st = shiftByTrial.get(`${r.aid}|${r.tid}`);
    if (!st) continue;
    let t = r.t0;
    for (const [aoi, len] of r.runs) {
      for (let k = 0; k < len; k++, t += STEP_MS) {
        if (t < 0 || t >= tHi) continue;
        const key = `${t}|${st}|${r.age_bin}|${r.word}`;
        let e = acc.get(key);
        if (!e) acc.set(key, e = {
          t, shift_type: st, age_bin: r.age_bin, word: r.word, n: 0, s: 0,
        });
        e.n += 1;
        // proportion looking at the *other* image than the onset image
        if (st === "T-D" ? aoi === 1 : aoi === 0) e.s += 1;
      }
    }
  }
  return Array.from(acc.values(), (e) => ({
    t: e.t, shift_type: e.shift_type, age_bin: e.age_bin, word: e.word,
    n: e.n, prop_shifted: e.s / e.n,
  })).sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);
}
```

```{ojs onset-plot}
{
  const facets = new Set(onsetData.map((d) => d.age_bin));
  return Plot.plot({
    width, height: Math.max(360, 240 * Math.ceil(facets.size / 2)),
    grid: true,
    x: { label: "Time (msec)" },
    y: { label: "Prop. shifting from onset image", domain: [0, 1] },
    color: { legend: true, label: "Word" },
    fy: facets.size > 1 ? { label: null } : undefined,
    marks: [
      Plot.lineY(onsetData.filter((d) => d.shift_type === "D-T"), {
        x: "t", y: "prop_shifted", stroke: "word",
        ...(facets.size > 1 ? { fy: "age_bin" } : {}),
      }),
      Plot.lineY(onsetData.filter((d) => d.shift_type === "T-D"), {
        x: "t", y: "prop_shifted", stroke: "word", strokeDasharray: "5 4",
        ...(facets.size > 1 ? { fy: "age_bin" } : {}),
      }),
      Plot.ruleY([0.5], { strokeDasharray: "4 4" }),
      Plot.ruleX([0], { strokeDasharray: "4 4" }),
    ],
  });
}
```

### Data

```{ojs onset-table}
Inputs.table(onsetData, {
  format: { prop_shifted: (d) => d.toFixed(3) },
})
```

:::

## Ages

Distribution of participant ages at test in the selected datasets.

```{ojs age-hist}
Plot.plot({
  width, height: 300,
  x: { label: "Age (months)" },
  y: { label: "Administrations" },
  color: { legend: true, label: "Dataset" },
  marks: [
    Plot.rectY(joined.length
      ? Array.from(new Map(joined.map((r) => [`${r.dataset}|${r.aid}`, r])).values())
      : [],
      Plot.binX({ y: "count" }, { x: "age", fill: "dataset", interval: 3 })),
  ],
})
```
